subject: MSA intake: regional hosting constraints, signer path & security evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Lewis <jordan@acme.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MSA/order form intake: hosting residency, signer matrix and SOC2 evidence

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this — we're excited to get Redwood onboarded. I attached our initial Order Form (Acme_OrderForm_v1.docx) and a short security Q&A. A few asks from our side to help legal/procurement scope the review: 

- Hosting residency requirement: All production data must remain in us-west (no EU/third-party processing).
- Expected seat counts: starting at 25 seats, growing to ~200 over 12 months — want to confirm how seat metrics map to billing.
- Signer authority: need to confirm who from Acme will sign (we'll provide a signer matrix), and whether Redwood prefers the standard MSA or if you accept counterparty redlines up front.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 report and data retention/audit-log details. If SOC2 is available as redacted PDF, please send.
- Timeline: target contract execution by Aug 15 to hit product launch.

Can your team confirm which MSA template you'll start from and any mandatory exhibits we should expect? Also attaching Acme_SignerMatrix.xlsx for preliminary routing.

Thanks — let us know if you prefer a quick intake call this week.

Jordan Lewis
Head of Procurement, Acme, Inc.
(jordan@acme.com)

Attachments: Acme_OrderForm_v1.docx (docx), Acme_SignerMatrix.xlsx (xlsx), Acme_Security_QA.pdf (pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lewis <jordan@acme.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MSA/order form intake: hosting residency, signer matrix and SOC2 evidence

Jordan — thanks for the packet and timeline. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (onboarding/ops) to handle redlines and provisioning. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Template: we'll start from Redwood's standard MSA (we find it speeds review), and we'll circulate a redline draft to Acme. If you prefer to kick off with counterparty redlines, we can accept those but it usually adds an extra review cycle — let me know your preference.
- Residency: we can commit to us-west only for production for this customer tier, but we need to confirm the specific residency clause in Exhibit B — Kimberly, can you confirm exact language we should provide?
- Seats/billing: Marissa will map seat tiers to billing metrics and share a draft Order Form with the seat-breakdown and prorated ramp options.
- Security: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report. Kimberly: can you advise if Acme's Security_QA raises any immediate blockers?
- Timeline: Aug 15 target is tight but achievable if we close initial redlines by 7/28. Please confirm whether Acme will accept Redwood's template to accelerate.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kimberly to produce initial MSA redline (target 7/22).
2) Marissa to circulate an amended Order Form with seat billing options (target 7/21).
3) Short intake call if needed — suggest Tue 7/22 10am PT.

I'll attach a short intake worksheet for your completion (helps us capture signatory names/PO requirements).

Cheers,
Irene
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
(irene.choi@redwood.com)

Attachments: RDW_Intake_Worksheet.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Fwd: Initial MSA/order form intake: hosting residency, signer matrix and SOC2 evidence

Suggested approach: 1) produce redline to Redwood template with comment summary; 2) flag any non-starter Acme asks; 3) provide short bullets for CSM/onboarding re: provisioning constraints.

Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 14:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MSA/order form intake: hosting residency, signer matrix and SOC2 evidence

Thanks Irene — Redwood template sounds fine to our legal team if it speeds the timeline. We can accept starting from your MSA and we'll surface any counterparty redlines after your draft. A couple clarifications: 

- We'll confirm final signer names by EOD Monday and upload an updated Acme_SignerMatrix.xlsx.
- Seat ramp: we'll aim for 25 at launch and will share a 12-month forecast — billing prefers monthly metered seats with a quarterly reconciliation.
- SOC2: attached a short answers doc; can you send the redacted SOC2 and the audit contact?

Happy to take the 7/22 intake call — Tue 10am PT works.

Jordan
Head of Procurement, Acme, Inc.

Attachments: Acme_Security_QA.pdf (pdf)
